description: This file defines the HandlerStack class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, responsible for creating and managing a stack of middleware for HTTP request handling. It includes methods for constructing the stack, adding/removing middleware, and executing the handler chain.

classes.name: HandlerStack
classes.description: Manages a stack of middleware handlers for HTTP requests, allowing creation, configuration, and execution of layered middleware chains.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a default HandlerStack with middleware for errors, redirects, cookies, and body preparation, optionally wrapping a provided handler.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a HandlerStack with an optional underlying HTTP handler.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes the handler stack as a callable, passing a request and options.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the handler stack for debugging.

methods.name: setHandler
methods.description: Sets the underlying HTTP handler callable that returns a promise.

methods.name: hasHandler
methods.description: Checks if a handler has been set.

methods.name: unshift
methods.description: Adds middleware to the bottom of the stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds middleware to the top of the stack.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Inserts middleware before another middleware by name.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Inserts middleware after another middleware by name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes middleware from the stack by instance or name.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Assembles and returns the composed handler callable from the middleware stack.
